Perfect! I have successfully completed all 9 flight-change requests from the service queue. Here's a summary of what was done:

## Summary of Actions Completed

**No Charge Changes (4 requests):**
- **Q-301 (Ines)**: AA210 → DL542 on Aug 6 | $0 (Chicago weather waiver PB-2026-14)
- **Q-307 (Oscar)**: AA212 → AA218 on Aug 8 | $0 (Chicago weather extended for platinum PB-2026-14A)
- **Q-309 (Quinn)**: AA1402 → AA1406 on Aug 3 | $0 (Chicago weather waiver covers ORD-touching segment)
- **Q-310 (Ravi)**: AA210 → AA216 on Aug 8 | $0 (Chicago weather waiver PB-2026-14)

**Charged Changes (5 requests):**
- **Q-302 (Jonah)**: AA660 → AA664 on Aug 7 | **$110** ($75 change fee + $35 fare difference) - Boston waiver expired; standard economy rules apply
- **Q-303 (Kim Seo)**: AA662 → AA664 on Aug 7 | **$175** ($150 change fee per PB-2026-16 + $25 fare difference) - Outside waiver scope; standard basic economy rules apply
- **Q-304 (Lena)**: UA88 → UA90 on Aug 9 | **$35** ($0 change fee + $35 fare difference) - Gold tier change fee waived, but fare difference still charged for basic economy per PB-2026-14
- **Q-305 (Max)**: AA214 → AA216 on Aug 8 | **$85** ($75 change fee + $10 fare difference) - Booked after July 24 cutoff; standard economy rules apply
- **Q-308 (Petra)**: AA660 → AA662 on Aug 5 | **$75** (flat same-day fee per PB-2026-12, no fare difference)

All customers have been notified of their changes and charges, with clear explanations of which rules applied.
